'''Skinkoon''' is a [[Water]] type [[Specialist]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Skinklet]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Ninjaguana]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Looks like nothing's happening, but Skinkoon has already finished a full combo. That's the trick. Time to rest... Hey! Who spilled water here?"

Skinkoon is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A bipedal, bright cyan, and purple lizard with a white underbelly. It has large eyes with blue irises and cyan eyelids. Its tail is as large as its body and is curled like a chameleon tail.

Skinkoon's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] variant changes its purple spots to pink and reddish-purple instead.

== Evolution Trial ==
Skinkoon's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Ninjaguana]] you need to complete the following two tasks:
* Feed Skinkoon to increase stats 3 times.
* Play Snowboard Sprint/Marathon Party (use x2000 boards) or Fishing Contest (use x2000 fertilizer).

== Trivia ==
* Before update 9/19/25, Skinkloon's description read: "A secret evolution path for Skinkoon is to eat nuclear waste, go to Japan, and call itself a kaiju."
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Skinkoon says Tatari curse words when it doesn't want to go to work, and... Well, that's pretty much all it ever says."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Silent, agile, and completely invisible underwater, Skinkoons's favorite hobby is diving. A great time to observe and mimic other Tatari."
